== Objectives ==
Speak to Artahla Starstrider in Thunder Bluff.

== Description ==
The wisdom of your travels can be seen clearly. I think it is time to speak with Artahla Starstrider once more and dive deeper into the lore of your people. She will be able to teach you new spells to help you on your quest. Meet her on the Spirit Rise in Thunder Bluff.

== Completion ==
You've returned. It is time to open a new chapter in your spiritual journey.
